On bad weather days, using a stationary bike or doing at-home workouts is a great way to stay active. Keep up the good work!Your blood pressure has been something you've needed to monitor closely. You're trying to cut back on sodium and drink more water, which seems to help.Your cholesterol numbers were a mixed bag. On the positive side, your HDL(good cholesterol) was 58 mg/dL, which is in a good range. Your triglycerides were 140 mg/dL, which is slightly elevated but not too concerning. Your doctor advised you to increase your intake of healthy fats like avocados and nuts and to cut back on saturated fats.Your vitamin D levels came back at 22 ng/mL, which is considered deficient.
